title: Coefficient point tensor, signed symmetry and normalized sections data
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. On the actual quotient point tower and small pro-etale sequence module categories [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site, lem-coef-hom-tower-scalar-model], use the native quotient levels and transition maps [def-weil-compact-support-native-system-evaluation] and define the commutative quotient-ring presentation and transport its pointwise tensor to the recorded module category. Define ordinary point-sections, geometric direct-image [def-sp-varying-ring-operations] and scalar-restriction lax tensor data by their values on every local pure tensor, using the recorded semilinear tensor sections [def-coef-semilinear-system-models] and sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Define derived quotient and integral point tensor data by universal signed-total localization [def-sf-coefficient-projection-adjunction-data], and the quotient symmetry by the signed swap on every total summand. For a scheme morphism use the pro-etale base-change functor [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] to define the terminal-object pullback isomorphism and the ordinary and derived point-sections composition data, normalized on sections and on the universal derived units. These are data and compatibility predicates, not existence assertions.
